question: In ∆ABC and ∆DEF, ∠A = 55°, AB = DE, AC = DF, ∠E = 85° and ∠F = 40°. By which property are ∆ABC and ∆DEF congruent?
solution:
Given:

∠A = 55º

 AB = DE

AC = DF

∠E = 85°

∠F = 40°

Formula used:

Sum of angles of the triangle = 180º

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dad3192eb3efd7350e3f3424f3b8604b85fa022a9b8ab26764567ce20e86ab10.png] 

In ∆DEF

⇒ ∠D + ∠E + ∠F = 180

⇒ ∠D = 180 - 85 - 40 = 55°

So, In ∆ABC and ∆DEF

⇒ AB = DE

⇒ AC = DF

⇒ and ∠A = ∠D = 55º

So, It is congruent by SAS rule

**⇒ Hence, Option 1 is correct**
